notes: One entry per pack or single model. Written by hand for verification fields; download fields are updated by tools/assets/download_assets.py.

verification.status: VERIFIED = confirmed from the live source page or a license file inside a downloaded archive. SEARCH_CORROBORATED = a search-engine result for the official page or listing states it; the live page was not read. LICENSE_UNVERIFIED = only the original brief claims it. No entry is VERIFIED yet.

download.status: BLOCKED = this build container's network policy answered HTTP 403 to CONNECT for the host (2026-10-20); nothing was retried or bypassed. MANUAL_DOWNLOAD_REQUIRED = the site needs an interactive step even with open network access. DOWNLOADED is set only after a file exists, passes the archive checks and has a SHA-256 below.
covers lists the checklist IDs (docs/assets/ASSET_INVENTORY.md) the pack is expected to supply, taken from its description. Confirm against the archive contents after download.
tools/assets/validate_assets.py refuses to let any model ship from an entry that is not VERIFIED.

Read this page's description before publishing. Safe handling: ship converted models inside the game with the credit line above and never republish the raw pack as a standalone download (raw archives are git-ignored by design). Set #3 of this series is paid and must not be downloaded.
